import time,statistics,numpy as np,mlx.core as mx
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors as Sk
from mlxlearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
from mlxlearn._common.config import tuning_context
X=load_iris().data.astype('f');Q=X[120:].copy();X=X[:120].copy()
with tuning_context(force_backend='mlx'):
 model=NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5).fit(X); index=model._index_; device=index.device_index
 qm=mx.array(Q)
 for name,call in [('native',lambda:device.query(qm,5,_validated=True,_squared=True)),('boundary',lambda:index.query(Q,5)),('public',lambda:model.kneighbors(Q)),('sklearn_brute',lambda:sk.kneighbors(Q)),('sklearn_auto',lambda:sk.kneighbors(Q))]:
  if name.startswith('sklearn'):sk=Sk(n_neighbors=5,algorithm=name.split('_')[1],n_jobs=1).fit(X)
  end=time.perf_counter()+.7
  while time.perf_counter()<end:
   val=call()
   if name=='native':mx.eval(*val)
  total=[]
  for _ in range(100):
   start=time.perf_counter();val=call()
   if name=='native':mx.eval(*val)
   total.append((time.perf_counter()-start)*1e6)
  print(name,statistics.median(total),flush=True)
